title: Showcase: My Custom-Built NEXUS ALGO BOT RSI + EMA + MACD Strategy
author: solokingtech
selftext:
"Hi everyone! 🤖

I am an independent developer, and I have recently developed my own NEXUS ALGO BOT v1.0. This bot is built on a robust trading strategy using RSI + EMA Ribbon + MACD.  

I have been testing it extensively on Paper Trading, and it is performing very accurately.  

Key Features of the Bot:

Professional Risk Management: It includes ATR-based Dynamic Stop Loss and Take Profit levels to protect capital.  

Safety First: It features a 'Daily Loss Circuit Breaker' to prevent excessive losses.  

Real-time Notifications: You receive instant live updates for every trade directly on Telegram.  

Transparency: Every trade is automatically saved in a CSV file log for easy tracking.  

I have prepared a Complete Setup Guide (README) and a ZIP package for this project.  

If anyone is interested in reviewing the logic or testing it out, please let me know. I would highly value your professional feedback! 🙏"
